answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 7401 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible for a Muslim man to look at a another man whose satr is not covered? Question: Is it permissible for a Muslim man to look at a another man whose satr is not covered? Answer ID: 7401 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1628/1396=B/1429) No, it is impermissible and haram. It is allowed for spouses and for doctors only as much as needed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
